id: 585-隋助沙缽略可汗擊阿波可汗之戰
theater: 河西走廊中段涼州至吐谷渾腹地

battle.name: 隋助沙缽略可汗擊阿波可汗之戰
battle.theater: 河西走廊中段涼州至吐谷渾腹地
battle.brief: 開皇五年冬，吐谷渾別帥阿波可汗寇涼州，東部沙缽略可汗兵敗降隋願為鄉導。隋遣上柱國韋沖、襄州總管韋世康出師，參贊陳樹用誘敵設伏之策，開皇六年在吐谷渾腹地大破之。卡面那件羅馬標槍在河西並無蹤跡，只能與本役靠嚮導、伏兵同糧道取勝的做法對照。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩方是隋朝與吐谷渾。隋文帝楊堅在開皇年間剛剛平定北方，中原初定而河西邊防空虛，涼州一線由高平王弘鎮守，軍政交由上柱國、總管一級的漢族將領主持，與北方游牧政權的關係沿用前朝的羈縻加互市辦法：定期朝貢、承認可汗號、准許商隊過境抽稅，一旦越界寇邊就用兵懲誡。開皇五年冬，吐谷渾別帥阿波可汗率眾寇涼州，涼州告急，於是有了這場由隋朝出兵、外藩內應的戰役。吐谷渾是鮮卑慕容氏的別支，三世紀末自甘松西徙到青海湖與柴達木盆地一帶，都城在伏俟城，控住河西通往西域的南道，靠畜牧與商路抽稅立國。五世紀末六世紀初，吐谷渾內部分裂為東西兩部與若干小部，號令由各部共推，實力並不齊一。沙缽略可汗是吐谷渾可汗之子，領東部一系；阿波可汗是別帥，據西部與王庭相鄰的草場，兵多將廣。兩部互相攻伐，最後是阿波可汗勝出，沙缽略一系被打散，於是才有向隋請援一事。
countriesEn: The two parties were the Sui dynasty and the Tuyuhun. Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, had only just settled northern China in the Kaihuang era; the interior was new and the western frontier was thin, with the line at Liangzhou held by Prince Gaoping, Hong, and the military administration run by Han Chinese commanders of the rank of pillar of state and circuit intendant. Relations with the northern nomads followed the inherited system of the previous dynasty: regular tribute, recognition of the khan's title, permission for caravans to pass and pay tolls, and military punishment whenever a raid crossed the border. In the winter of the fifth year of Kaihuang, 585, the Tuyuhun commander Abobo Khan led his people across the border into Liangzhou; the city was in danger, and out of this came a war fought by Sui troops with a foreign prince as their guide inside. The Tuyuhun were a branch of the Xianbei Murong clan; by the end of the third century they had moved west from Gansong to the region of Qinghai Lake and the Qaidam Basin, with their capital at Fusi city, holding the southern road that linked Hexi to the western regions, and they lived on herding and on tolls taken from the trade. Late in the fifth and early in the sixth century the polity split into an eastern and a western part together with a number of smaller groups, the title of khan being pushed forward collectively by the various tribes and the real strength unevenly distributed. Khan Shaboluo was a son of the Tuyuhun khan and headed the eastern branch; Abobo Khan was a separate commander who held the western pastures adjacent to the royal court, with far more men and better generals. The two branches fought each other, and in the end Abobo Khan prevailed and Shaboluo's line was scattered, which is what made the appeal to Sui possible.
people: 主帥是隋朝上柱國韋沖，關中杜陵人，出身將門，父親是北周大將韋孝寬，開皇年間以治軍嚴整著稱，出師前已在西北效力，熟習邊情。副手是襄州總管韋世康，同出關中武將之家，負責兵事的推進與糧道。真正決定打法的是隨軍參贊的陳樹，《隋書》為他立傳，記他在開皇五年的行動中提出一套料敵之計：吐谷渾無城郭、無積聚，全靠草場與水源立身，騎兵來去疾如風，主力一旦拉得過深、糧道一斷，部眾必然散走；因此不可與其正面硬碰一路追擊，應以精兵在前誘敵深入，把大軍佈在後方險要之處，等敵人追疲再縱兵擊之。韋沖從其計，先遣輕騎挑戰，吐谷渾果然追來，隋軍設伏，大破之。阿波可汗這一邊，他本是別帥，靠整合西部諸部坐大，此戰一敗，眾叛土崩，數年之間西部渾零。吐谷渾那一側的另一個關鍵人物是沙缽略可汗，他不但是隋軍的嚮導，還帶來了內部的地緣知識：哪一片草場養得起多少騎兵、哪一道水源在初春還能取到、哪條山道可以讓大軍通過。這場仗能打成，靠的就是這份內應。
peopleEn: The commander was the Sui pillar of state Wei Chong, a man from Duling in the Guanzhong region, born into a military family: his father was the Northern Zhou general Wei Xiaokuan, and Wei Chong himself was known in the Kaihuang era for strict discipline, having already served in the northwest and knowing the frontier well. His colleague was Wei Shikang, circuit intendant of Xiangzhou, also from a military family of Guanzhong, who took charge of pushing the advance forward and of the supply road. What really decided the method of the fight was Chen Shu, who accompanied the army as staff officer; the History of Sui devotes a biography to him and records the plan he proposed during the action of the fifth year of Kaihuang. The Tuyuhun had no walled towns and no stores; they lived entirely off pasture and water, and their horse moved like the wind. If the main body was drawn too deep and the supply line was cut, the host would certainly scatter. So one should not meet them in a hard-fought running pursuit; instead a small body of picked troops should go in front to draw them on, the main army should be posted at a defile behind them, and the attack should be launched only after the enemy had spent itself in the pursuit. Wei Chong followed this plan: light horse went forward to give battle, the Tuyuhun came after as expected, and the Sui ambushed them and routed them. On the other side, Abobo Khan had begun as a mere commander and had grown strong by welding the western tribes together; once he was beaten in this battle his following dissolved, and within a few years the western half of the Tuyuhun was a scatter of fragments. The other decisive figure on the Tuyuhun side was Khan Shaboluo. He was not only the guide for the Sui army; he also brought with him the inner geographical knowledge of the realm: which pasture could feed how many riders, which watercourse could still be drawn on in early spring, and which mountain track would carry a great army through. That this war could be fought at all rested on that intelligence.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬標槍，共和末期到帝國前期羅馬軍團的制式投射兵器：木製槍桿中段掏空、上套鐵箍，槍頸為鐵製，命中盾牌後槍桿即折斷留在盾面，敵人拔不出來，雙手被半截槍纏住，只能退回掩體。公元五八五年的河西走廊沒有這件東西，羅馬標槍與吐谷渾之間沒有任何可考的關聯，它只能拿來當對照。真正值得對照的並非外形，而是它背後那套配發制度：標槍是定點齊射的消耗品，每名士兵一次攜帶若干支，射完即棄，營內再按冊補發，一次會戰下來消耗掉整支軍隊的份量；羅馬會戰的縱深不過幾百步到一里，後方配發線短，制度才運作得起。河西走廊的投射武器是另一套：吐谷渾騎兵用角背複合弓，箭矢價低可以回收，隋軍步騎用蹶張弓與床子弩，弩矢昂貴回收麻煩，兩邊都靠射手技藝與馬上的穩定取勝。至於真正卡住隋軍的不是武器，而是馬匹、飲水與乾糧：青海高原草場與水源有限，初春河未開、風大乾冷，長距離出兵必然拖垮一支以牛車運糧的隊伍。隋軍當時的裝備大致是：騎兵用長槊與環首刀，步兵以矛戟成陣，弩手居中壓制，輜重靠橐車與牛車，糧由涼州、雍州一線轉運。吐谷渾那邊則是氈帳、牛羊群與成片的馬牧，自帶補給，這是他們能在大漠裡長期機動的底子。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman pilum, the standard missile of the Roman army from the late Republic into the early Empire: a wooden shaft hollowed in the middle and bound with an iron collar, with an iron neck, and after it struck a shield the shaft snapped and stayed in the shield face. The man hit could not pull it out, his hands were tangled by the broken stub, and he could only fall back behind his cover. There was no such thing in the Hexi Corridor in 585, and no traceable connection runs between the Roman pilum and the Tuyuhun; it can only serve as a comparison. What is really worth comparing is not the shape but the system of issue behind it. The pilum was a consumable fired in volleys from a fixed position: each soldier carried a certain number, they were thrown away once spent, and the magazines behind the lines issued them again by roll, so that a single battle consumed the allotment of an entire army. The depth of a Roman battle was no more than a few hundred paces to a mile, the issue line behind was short, and only then did the system work. The missiles of the Hexi corridor belonged to a different order entirely. The Tuyuhun horse used a horn-backed composite bow whose arrows were cheap and recoverable; Sui foot and horse used the strong drawn crossbow and the crossbow on a frame, whose bolts were costly and awkward to recover, and on both sides the result turned on the skill of the archer and his stability on horseback. What truly held the Sui army back was not the weapon but horses, water and dry rations. The pastures and water sources of the Qinghai plateau are limited; in early spring the rivers are still frozen; the wind is hard and the cold dry, and any long march would break a column that carried its grain on ox carts. The equipment of the Sui force was in outline: cavalry with long sha and ring-pommel sabres, infantry drawn up in a line of spears and halberds, crossbowmen posted in the centre to press the enemy, and baggage moved on straw carts and ox waggons with grain brought up from the Liangzhou and Yongzhou lines. On the Tuyuhun side there were felt tents, herds of cattle and sheep, and wide horse pastures: they carried their own supply, and that was the foundation of their ability to manoeuvre for long stretches in the desert.
tactics: 這場仗沒有攻城戰，因為對手沒有城。吐谷渾是游牧政權，遇戰則散，遇險則走，隋軍因此打的是一場追擊、誘敵與伏擊並用的運動戰，與中原會戰的套路完全不同。出兵之後，隋軍自涼州沿祁連山北麓西行，前出輕騎搜索，沙缽略一系的嚮導在前帶路，大軍在後續進，糧車夾在隊伍中間，車陣兼作拒馬與射手的掩體。陳樹的計策是全戰役的骨幹：不以大軍硬追，而以少量精騎在前方挑釁，把阿波可汗的追兵引向預設的險要地帶，等敵人馬力耗盡、隊形拉長，再由大軍四面合擊，斷其歸路。韋沖照計而行，追擊一旦成功，隋軍一路追入腹地，在曼柏一帶完成決定性的一擊，此地名各家定位不一，大致落在祁連山北麓至青海海西之間。吐谷渾方面，阿波可汗的騎兵在會戰之前佔盡上風，憑速度與對地形的熟悉屢次衝擊隋軍側翼；一旦失了先手被拖進狹窄谷地，密集的騎陣便拉不開，弓手的射界被自己人擋住，崩潰來得很快。隋軍的追擊沒有停：敵眾四散，奪其馬匹、牛羊與帳幕，一直追到敵營。地形與氣候也決定了這一點：初春的河谷未開，渡口成了瓶頸；高原的午後風一起，揚塵蔽目，騎兵失去了貼身纏鬥的機會，勝負便在這樣的間隙裡分出來。
tacticsEn: There was no siege in this war, because the enemy had no cities. The Tuyuhun were a pastoral polity that scattered at contact and moved off when pressed, so the Sui army fought a war of pursuit, of the lure and of the ambush rather than a set-piece battle in the Chinese manner. After the force set out, it marched west from Liangzhou along the northern foot of the Qilian mountains, light horse pushed out to scout, the guide from Shaboluo's line led the way at the head, the main body followed behind, and the grain waggons were kept in the middle of the column, the cart line serving as a barricade and as cover for the archers. Chen Shu's plan was the backbone of the whole operation: no hard pursuit by the main army, but a small body of picked horse in front giving battle, drawing Abobo Khan's pursuers towards a defile chosen in advance, and once the enemy had spent its horses and stretched its formation, the main army falling on from several sides and cutting the road back. Wei Chong followed this, and once the pursuit began the Sui troops drove straight into the heartland of the Tuyuhun and struck the decisive blow in the region of Manbai, a name whose location is variously given but which generally lies between the northern foot of the Qilian mountains and the Haixi region of Qinghai. On the Tuyuhun side, Abobo Khan's horse held every advantage before the engagement, striking the flanks of the Sui columns again and again on the strength of their speed and their familiarity with the ground; but once they were checked and drawn into a narrow valley the tight formation of horse could no longer open out, the archers' line of fire was blocked by their own men, and the collapse came quickly. The Sui pursuit did not stop: the enemy scattered, their horses, cattle, sheep and tents were taken, and the pursuit was carried up to the camp. Terrain and climate had their part in it as well. The river valleys were still frozen in early spring and the fords were a bottleneck; and when the plateau wind rose in the afternoon and filled the air with dust, the horse lost the chance to fight at close quarters, and that was how the battle was decided.
data: 留下數字的只有《隋書》與《資治通鑑》的零星幾筆。兵力方面，阿波可汗入寇涼州記為「率眾十二萬」，這是史書對游牧大軍的慣用概數，實際能戰的騎兵當在數萬之數；隋軍方面記作步騎二萬，但二萬顯然只指首批出發的精兵或其中一部，本體大軍與後續糧隊當另有數萬。損失沒有精確數，戰利也只有概數：會戰破敵之後，隋軍俘其名王，記「虜男女十餘萬口，獲牛羊駱駝數十萬頭」，這類數字出於史書的概寫，遠高於實情，只能當作敵傾巢而出、此役大勝的量級看待。距離可以算出來：自涼州到吐谷渾王庭伏俟城所在的青海湖一帶，直線約二百五十公里，循祁連山道則倍之；隋軍出師到會戰，前後歷時約一年，因為出師在開皇五年冬，決戰在開皇六年。年月方面，《高祖紀》只於開皇五年「冬」字下記吐谷渾入寇涼州、遣韋沖等討之，確切月份今不可考，本卡取十二月為冬季末的推定值。戰場位置《隋書》不載具體地名，只說「破之」，後世常以曼柏一帶指稱隋軍與吐谷渾交戰之地，但定位眾說紛紜，本卡坐標取涼州（武威），即隋軍出師地與爭端的邊界所在。卡面那件兵器則更早：羅馬標槍是共和末期至帝國前期的裝備，五世紀已退出一線，五八五年更不可能出現在河西。
dataEn: Only a few figures survive, in scattered lines of the History of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance. On strength, Abobo Khan's incursion into Liangzhou is recorded as leading twelve thousand tens of men, the customary round number Chinese historians used for a nomad host; the horse actually able to fight was certainly in the tens of thousands at most. The Sui force is recorded as two thousand foot and horse, but that figure plainly covers only the picked troops that marched out first, or one part of them, the main body and the follow-on supply trains being several tens of thousands more. There are no precise loss figures, and the booty is given only in round terms: after the enemy was broken, the Sui took his nobles captive, and the record says some hundred thousand men and women were taken together with tens of thousands of cattle, sheep and camels. Such numbers are gross generalisations by the historians, far above the truth, and can only be read as the scale of an enemy who had committed everything and of a great Sui victory. Distance can be computed: from Liangzhou to Fusi city, the Tuyuhun royal seat by Qinghai Lake, is about two hundred and fifty kilometres in a straight line, and rather more by the road over the Qilian mountains. From the setting out of the army to the battle a year passed, for the march began in the winter of the fifth year of Kaihuang and the decision was fought in the sixth. As to date and month, the Annals of Emperor Wen record only under the character for winter in the fifth year of Kaihuang that the Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou and that Wei Chong and the rest were sent against them; the exact month cannot now be established, and this card takes December as a reasoned estimate of the end of the winter season. The place of the battle is not given a specific name in the History of Sui, which says only that the enemy was broken; later writers often point to the district of Manbai for the meeting of the Sui and the Tuyuhun, but the localisation is much disputed, and the coordinates on this card are taken at Liangzhou, Wuwei, which is the place the army marched from and the frontier over which the quarrel was fought. The weapon on the card is far older: the Roman pilum belongs to the equipment of the late Republic and the early Empire, had left the front line by the fifth century, and could not possibly have appeared on the Hexi in 585.
cause: 打起上來的根由，是吐谷渾內部的分裂加上涼州邊防的壓力。阿波可汗整合西部諸部之後，兵眾遠多於東部的沙缽略一系，開皇五年冬便率眾深入涼州，殺傷擄掠，驅趕畜群；沙缽略兵敗，據說連妻子都被俘走，無力自復。走投無路之下，他派使者到長安，請求歸附，並表示願意做鄉導，導隋軍討伐阿波可汗。隋文帝立刻抓住這個機會：一來涼州是關中屏障，吐谷渾的鐵騎就壓在京畿西面；二來河西通往西域的商路被吐谷渾掐著，隋朝在西北的影響力要往西推，正需要一個內應。於是沙缽略被封為歸義可汗，授將軍之號，隋軍隨即出師。從朝廷的角度看，這是一筆以小搏大的買賣：用一支遠征兵和一個外族內應，換邊境的安寧與商路的暢通；從吐谷渾的角度看，這是部族聯盟政治下的一次內戰，隋朝不過是借來的手。
causeEn: The root of the fighting was the division inside the Tuyuhun, together with the pressure on the defence of Liangzhou. Once Abobo Khan had welded the western tribes together, his host was far larger than that of the eastern line under Shaboluo, and in the winter of the fifth year of Kaihuang he drove his people deep into Liangzhou, killing, taking captives and driving off the herds. Shaboluo was beaten, and by the general account even his wife and children were carried off, leaving him unable to recover his position. With nowhere else to turn, he sent envoys to Chang'an, asked to submit, and offered to serve as guide for a Sui army that would attack Abobo Khan. Emperor Wen of Sui seized the chance at once. In the first place Liangzhou was the shield of Guanzhong and the Tuyuhun cavalry sat on the western flank of the capital region. In the second, the Tuyuhun held the choke of the trade road from Hexi to the western regions, and if Sui influence in the northwest was to push westward it needed an agent inside. Shaboluo was therefore invested as Khan who returns to right, granted the rank of general, and the Sui army marched out at once. From the court's point of view this was a good bargain: a distant column of troops and one foreign prince as guide, in exchange for quiet on the frontier and an open trade road. From the point of view of the Tuyuhun it was a civil war in the politics of a tribal league, and the Sui had simply borrowed a hand to fight it.
impact: 這一役的影響，遠遠超過它在戰場上取得的東西。第一，隋朝第一次在河西用「外藩內應加遠征兵」的打法處理邊患，此後被寫進隋唐將領的經典；《隋書》為隨軍參贊陳樹立傳，把這一策的來龍去脈記得清清楚楚，等於把一次戰役變成了一份教科書。第二，吐谷渾從此再難作為統一的對手存在：西部崩解，各部重新分成小塊，隋朝得以用冊封可汗、准許互市、設郡置縣的辦法把它慢慢收編，絲路南道重新向中原打開，而代價是從此多了一層羈縻與朝貢的關係。第三，涼州邊境在往後十多年裡相對安靜，直到隋煬帝大業年間才又大規模用兵，但那時的戰役已是另一種性質：隋朝要的不是報復，而是把青海與西域直接變成郡縣。第四，這一役在戰術層面留下一個反覆被引用的樣本：主力不與游牧騎兵正面競逐速度，而是用嚮導熟悉的水源草場設伏，把追擊的節奏握在自己手裡。第五，從更大範圍看，這也是隋朝在西邊第一次把北方的內部整合變成對外優勢，東線的做法在西線得到了一次成功的複製。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign reached much further than anything it won on the field. First, the Sui handled a frontier problem on the Hexi by combining an insider prince with a distant column of troops, and the method was afterwards written into the classics of Sui and Tang commanders; the History of Sui devotes a biography to Chen Shu, the staff officer who went with the army, and sets out the whole course of the stratagem so clearly that a single battle has been turned into a textbook. Second, the Tuyuhun could never again exist as a single opponent: the west had broken up, the tribes fell back into small separate bodies, and the Sui was able to absorb them slowly by investing khans, allowing trade and establishing commanderies and counties. The southern silk road opened again towards the interior of China, and the price paid was a new layer of dependence and tribute. Third, the border at Liangzhou stayed comparatively quiet for more than ten years afterwards, until the Sui launched large campaigns again in the Daye era of Emperor Yang, by which time the nature of the fighting had changed: what the Sui now wanted was not revenge but to turn Qinghai and the western regions directly into commanderies and counties. Fourth, at the tactical level this campaign left behind a model that was quoted again and again: the main body did not compete with nomad horse in a straight race for speed, but used the guide's knowledge of water and pasture to lay an ambush and to hold the rhythm of the pursuit in its own hands. Fifth, in wider terms this was the first time the Sui turned the internal consolidation of the north into an external advantage in the west, and the method that had worked on the eastern front was copied successfully on the western one.
result: 結果是隋軍大勝：阿波可汗在腹地會戰中被破，名王被俘，大批馬匹、牛羊與帳幕被奪，西部各部隨即散伙，吐谷渾重新回到分裂狀態。沙缽略一系因為隋軍的介入得以復國，卻也從此再離不開隋廷的支持，名義上的可汗號與實際上的臣屬身分綁在一起；隋朝在涼州以西的邊防，則靠這批新附的部眾與後設的邊鎮一道維持。對這場戰爭的實際經過，現存記載仍有缺口：會戰的確切地名與日數沒有留下來，阿波可汗此後的下場只有眾叛一類的模糊說法，這些空白只能靠《隋書》與《資治通鑑》彼此對照補起來，不能當成精確的戰史。卡面那件兵器與這場戰役無關：羅馬標槍在五八五年的河西不存在，決定勝負的也不是任何投射武器，而是嚮導、伏兵、地形與補給線這四樣東西。
resultEn: The outcome was a great Sui victory. Abobo Khan was broken in the meeting in the heartland, his nobles were taken captive, great numbers of horses, cattle, sheep and tents were seized, the western tribes fell apart at once, and the Tuyuhun fell back into a divided state. Shaboluo's line was restored to its position by the intervention of the Sui army, but from that moment it could no longer do without the support of the Sui court: the title of khan in name and the status of a subject in fact were bound together. The Sui frontier west of Liangzhou was henceforth held by these newly attached groups together with the frontier posts set up afterwards. As for the actual course of the war, the surviving record still has gaps: the exact place and the number of days of the engagement were not preserved, and the fate of Abobo Khan after it survives only in vague statements about his following breaking away. Those gaps can be filled only by collating the History of Sui against the Comprehensive Mirror, and they must not be treated as an exact military history. The weapon on the card has nothing to do with this campaign. The Roman pilum did not exist on the Hexi in 585, and what decided the result was not any missile weapon but four things: the guide, the ambush, the ground and the supply line.
